video_summary.overall_goal: Demonstrate breathing exercise app workflow: start session, progress through inhale/exhale phases, and view saved sessions
video_summary.description: User opens Brethap breathing app, taps 'Press Start' to begin a new breathing session, observes 'Inhale' and 'PreExhale' phases with countdown timers, then navigates to Sessions screen to view saved breathing session history

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Brethap app main screen with title 'Brethap', large 'Press Start' button in center, timer showing '0:02:00', status bar at top with time '9:20'
steps.system_response: Screen transitions to breathing exercise in progress

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Exercise screen showing 'Inhale' instruction text in center, large blue circular progress indicator below text, countdown timer '0:01:56' (decrementing toward 0), status bar
steps.system_response: Timer counts down, user watches and follows breathing cue
steps.intent_task: Follow inhale breathing instruction during timed phase

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Exercise screen now shows 'PreExhale' text (note: appears to show 'PrExhale' due to rendering), large blue circular progress indicator, countdown timer '0:01:53' (continuing to decrement)
steps.system_response: Phase transitions automatically from Inhale to PreExhale, timer continues countdown
steps.visual_feedback: Text label changes from 'Inhale' to 'PreExhale', timer continues decrementing
steps.intent_task: Transition phase in breathing exercise and continue following cues

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Sessions history screen showing back arrow button, 'Sessions' header with 'Clear All' button on right. List displays three past sessions with timestamps and durations: (1) 2026-05-01 9:20 PM, 0:00:07, (2) 2026-05-01 9:20 PM, 0:00:05, (3) 2026-03-24 11:36 AM, 0:00:03. Each session has action buttons: Backup, Restore, Export.
steps.system_response: Navigation to Sessions screen showing saved breathing session history
steps.visual_feedback: Entire screen layout changes, list of historical sessions populated
steps.intent_task: Navigate to view saved breathing sessions and session history

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Sessions screen header visible with back arrow and 'Sessions' title, main content area appears mostly empty/loading (dark background below header), loading bar or content transition visible at bottom of screen
steps.system_response: Screen content loads or transitions (loading bar visible at bottom)

overall_flow: App launches on main screen with 'Press Start' button
User taps 'Press Start' to begin breathing exercise
Exercise progresses through breathing phases: Inhale → PreExhale with countdown timers
User navigates back to Sessions screen showing saved breathing history
Sessions screen displays list of 3 past sessions with timestamps, durations, and management actions
App shows loading or content refresh at end of video
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1 (0-2s): Tap 'Press Start' button on main screen to initiate breathing exercise.
Step 2 (2-8s): App displays 'Inhale' phase with countdown timer (0:01:56), user observes breathing instruction.
Step 3 (8-14s): Phase automatically transitions to 'PreExhale' with continuing countdown timer (0:01:53).
Step 4 (14-20s): Press back arrow to navigate to Sessions screen; view list of 3 saved breathing sessions with timestamps and action options.
Step 5 (20-23s): Sessions screen loading/transition animation completes.
